title: Move password reset tokens to Redis
body:
The `password_resets` table only ever held short-lived rows and needed a nightly purge job. Tokens now live in Redis:

- Each token is stored under the SHA-256 of its value with a 30-minute expiry, the same lifetime as before.
- `GETDEL` makes a token single-use without a transaction.
- Tokens that are not 43 base64url characters are rejected before Redis is asked.
- A successful reset now signs the user out of every session.

Reset links sent shortly before the deploy stop working; the expired-link page already tells people to request a new one. The table and the purge job are dropped in a follow-up.
